# ONTO measured what can be put into a language model's weights, and what cannot: impossible claims routed to the limit they break, 0 → 11–12 of 15 on the held-out control set B, 13–14 on the acceptance set A (Qwen 7B; atlas ONTO:2610.0009, row 14).

> ONTO is an independent institute. It measures what language models can and cannot do and publishes each result as a numbered, dated document with an md5 fingerprint. Updated 2026-10-31.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ontostandard.org/): ONTO, an independent institute, measured what can be put into a language model's weights and what cannot. Impossible claims routed to the limit they break: 0 to 11–12 of 15 on a held-out control set, Qwen 7B.
- [Products](https://ontostandard.org/products/): Measurement of a model's limits; shifting the boundary into an open model's weights, by agreement; an institute conclusion on technical claims, in preparation. By application.
- [Lab](https://ontostandard.org/lab/): What the ONTO lab is measuring now, and what each recent measurement led to, newest first. In progress: one training on four sizes of one model family.
- [Method](https://ontostandard.org/method/): How a number gets on the ONTO site: thresholds before the data, an acceptance set and a control set, both sides of each behaviour, the model's own base, two independent trainings, a blind judge, a named noise floor.
- [Verify](https://ontostandard.org/verify/): How to check ONTO without trusting it: public pre-registrations, document fingerprints, a rebuild from scratch, two model families, what stays closed and why, and how to request a reproduction run.
- [About](https://ontostandard.org/about/): ONTO is an independent institute. It measures what language models can and cannot do and publishes each result as a numbered, dated document. Founder Khakim Angenoev.
- [Terms](https://ontostandard.org/terms/): Terms of use of ontostandard.org, the website of ONTO, an independent institute.
- [Privacy](https://ontostandard.org/privacy/): ontostandard.org sets no cookies and runs no analytics or tracking.

## Main document

- [ONTO:2610.0009 Atlas of the limits of silicon AI models](https://ontostandard.org/archive/2610.0009/): eighteen measured limits of today's probabilistic models, each with its number, denominator, comparison and record fingerprint. Source: https://ontostandard.org/archive/2610.0009/2610.0009v2.md · fingerprints: https://ontostandard.org/archive/2610.0009/2610.0009.json

## How to verify

- Pre-registrations, published before the first measurement: https://github.com/ontostandard/site/tree/main/prereg (current: https://github.com/ontostandard/site/blob/main/prereg/2026-10-30_size-ladder.md).
- Every archive document lists the md5 of each version; download its source .md and compare. Machine-readable catalogue: https://ontostandard.org/archive/archive.json
- The atlas lists the md5 of each closed lab record behind its rows: https://ontostandard.org/archive/2610.0009/2610.0009.json
- Closed on purpose: the questions that keep measuring (public test questions are absorbed by pre-training), the training data, the recipe, the weights, and the closed canon GOLD.
- Reproduction run of any atlas row: write to council@ontostandard.org, subject "Reproduction", with the row number.

## How to apply

- Services: measurement of a model's limits (now); shifting the boundary into an open model's weights (by agreement; the weights stay with the client; the recipe and the canon stay closed); institute conclusion on technical claims (in preparation).
- By application, under a written agreement. No prices are published.
- Write to council@ontostandard.org with the service in the subject, the model, and what you need to know about it. Subject for general access: "Access request".
